product.title: Old Lahaina Luau Maui

description.text: Soak up Hawaiian history and culture at the 3-hour Old Lahaina Luau in Maui. Enjoy hula dancing, an oceanfront setting and fresh island fillets, as well as other traditional dishes. Stops include Old Lahaina Luau Grounds, Imu Ceremony, Oceanfront Performance Stage. You'll be greeted with a Hawaiian lei and tropical drink from the bar before settling in for a lively performance against the Maui sunset. Ideal for visitors basing on Maui who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
